name: Teaching and Research Practicum in Construction Engineering and Management
description: The goal of this course is to develop professional competencies in teaching, research methodology, and academic communication in fields related to construction engineering and management. Participants will gain hands-on experience in course development, delivering lectures, evaluation, writing research proposals, and managing labs.
